query: A Joint Project Mir Ten drops onto the bench beside you with a sketch of something that is either a self-stirring cauldron or a small war machine. "Partners? Your hands, my brain. Or the other way round. Both, actually." Work alone "Fair," says Mir, with no hard feelings, and is immediately on fire. Not badly. Partner with Mir The cauldron stirs itself, hums a tune and only threatens the professor once. Mir hugs you with oily hands. The prototype explodes. Mir laughs so hard they cry. "Again! We were so close!" You find you're laughing too. Build it on the spot You don't sketch it. You ask the bits what they want to be, and they become a cauldron that stirs and occasionally salutes. Mir makes a noise you've never heard a person make. "Partners," Mir says. "Forever. Probably."

Blueprints
Mir has drawn a blueprint for something for you. {~"A lamp that turns itself off when you fall asleep reading," they say. "Probably."|"A pocket that's bigger inside," they say. "In theory. In practice, it eats keys."} They don't say why they keep making things for you.
